# Resume Builder

Build, edit and download a professional PDF resume — right in your browser. No sign-up. No backend. No lock-in.

## Metadata
- **URL**: https://createresume.in
- **Repository**: https://github.com/SasiVeeramachaneni/resume
- **Type**: Web Application

## Key Pages
- [/](https://createresume.in/): Home page explaining features and templates.
- [/resume](https://createresume.in/resume): WYSWYG Resume Builder with live preview and PDF download.
- [/about](https://createresume.in/about): About page of the resume builder.
- [/tech](https://createresume.in/tech): Description of the technical stack used in this project.
- [/blog](https://createresume.in/blog): Index page listing blog posts on resume-building advice.
